scientific_integrity: One analytically proved classification and its spectral and finite-cutoff corollaries. The analytical proof establishes universal quantifiers; 1101 checks are corroborative only. The strict-ergodicity consequence uses already published compact-alphabet theory. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the nearest-neighbor tail j -> 0 (j-1) (j+1) with a finite nonnegative-integer stall, on the one-point compactification. Does not cover j-2 tails, other compactifications, or arbitrary substitutions. Older equivalent priority cannot be ruled out exhaustively.
title: All finite stalls are strictly ergodic in a nearest-neighbor compact-alphabet substitution
